title: Serit CC
description: serit.no Serit CC, formally C.C. Solution AS, is a Norwegian IT services company founded in 2007 in Bergen, providing cloud, cybersecurity, managed IT, Microsoft 365 and AI automation to small and medium businesses. It has 6 employees and annual revenue of around 17 million Norwegian kroner, and since June 2025 it is part of Serit, one of Norway's largest independent IT groups with 27 offices and over 200 specialists. The company holds Helsenett certification for healthcare clients and runs its own Norwegian data center, keeping all data inside the country. It is led by founder and CEO Christopher Andreas Namtvedt, a former NATO systems administrator, together with CTO Ole Erik Skare who has been with the firm for 17 years. Core strengths are deep Bergen market knowledge combined with the national scale of Serit group partnerships with Microsoft, Fortinet, Dell and Lenovo. A newer focus is secure AI adoption and workflow automation for business clients.
